releaseNotes:
﻿### Added
- Added a --self-test command-line switch to buildversion that proves the tool can start (loads native dependencies and builds the service provider) without doing any real work, exiting 0 on success or 1 with a one-line reason on stderr (#426)
### Fixed
- Fixed backslash path separators in ProjectReference paths to satisfy the msbuild-path-separator check
- Build number tag creation now re-reads the latest build-number tag and moves to the next free number when the number is already taken (HTTP 422), instead of retrying the same number, so concurrent builds no longer keep colliding on it (#408)
- Renamed the BuildNumberEnvVar test constant to BUILD_NUMBER_ENV_VAR to satisfy the IDE1006 naming rule (#405)
### Changed
- Switched test projects from xunit.v3.mtp-v2 to the Native AOT-compatible xunit.v3.aot.mtp-v2 and bumped FunFair.Test.Common/FunFair.Test.Source.Generator to 6.4.0.2617
- Dependencies - Updated CSharpIsNullAnalyzer to 0.2.19
- Restricted NuGet PackageReference asset flow (IncludeAssets) on non-analyzer packages to reduce build-time supply-chain risk, per meziantou.net guidance on limiting what NuGet packages can do
- Dependencies - Updated Microsoft.Sbom.Targets to 4.1.13
- Dependencies - Updated Microsoft.VisualStudio.Threading.Analyzers to 18.12.1
- Dependencies - Updated Roslynator.Analyzers to 5.0.1
- Dependencies - Updated SonarAnalyzer.CSharp to 10.35.0.4138
- Dependencies - Updated Nullable.Extended.Analyzer to 1.19.0
- Dependencies - Updated FunFair.Test to 6.4.7.2960
- Dependencies - Updated FunFair.Test.Source.Generator to 6.4.7.2960
- Dependencies - Updated Microsoft.Extensions to 10.0.14
- Dependencies - Updated Credfeto.Extensions.Linq to 1.0.165.2159
- Dependencies - Updated Credfeto.Version.Information.Generator to 1.0.142.1766
- Dependencies - Updated Credfeto.Enumeration to 1.2.158.2511
- Dependencies - Updated FunFair.CodeAnalysis to 7.2.25.2636
- SDK - Updated DotNet SDK to 11.0.100-rc.3.26522.148

- Updated to .NET 11 (net11.0, global.json SDK, runtime-async) - #421
